summary:
Detailed implementation plan for:
1. Universal Theme Switching (Dark/Light mode + 6 color presets across all platform pages).
2. Student Dashboard redesign with dynamic Referral QR code, 1-click referral link & ID copy, customizable promotion message templates, downline checkup with visual tree & searchable table, downline profile modal, and integrated Digital ID card.
3. Admin Panel upgrade with full referral genealogy tree (who is under whom), detailed registration form submission inspector, and profile edit audit history log.
